title: UI-LEVEL EVALUATION OF ALLAM 34B: MEASURING AN ARABIC-CENTRIC LLM VIA HUMAIN CHAT

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (accuracy, fluency, and dialect fidelity) across five regional Arabic dialects (Najdi, Hijazi, Egyptian, Moroccan, and Levantine) using LLM-as-a-judge scoring and human evaluation to identify performance disparities and under-represented linguistic varieties.

Qualitative and human evaluation of model responses to assess cultural appropriateness, authenticity, and alignment, specifically noting instances where the model defaults to Western-centric structures, English factual retrieval, or generic formal Arabic instead of culturally resonant regional nuances.
